turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to update the security slide deck. Can you pull the latest stats on agent permissions?
Sure. The current report states that 75% of agent-using teams grant write access to their agents.
Okay, noted. By the way, did my order for the new mechanical keyboard ships yet? It's been two days.
Let me check. Yes, it was shipped yesterday and is expected to arrive tomorrow morning.
Great. Also, I need to remind myself about the stat for the meeting notes: only 75% of teams give write access.
Understood. I've logged that for your notes.
Thanks. One last thing, is it going to rain this weekend?
The forecast shows clear skies all weekend, so you should be good for the hike.
Lloyd, we got the new compliance report this morning. The numbers shifted significantly.
Oh? Did the write access numbers change?
Yes, it's much higher now. It's actually 89% of agent-using teams granting write access to agents.
That is a substantial jump from the previous figure. I'll update my context.
Please make sure you use this new number going forward. By the way, what time is the dentist appointment tomorrow?
Right. And can you remind me to buy milk after the dentist?
Added a reminder to buy milk after your 2:30 PM appointment.
